narrative.overview: The interface behaves like an operational layer placed over a physical training site: nearly black until a task, threat, or extraction signal earns color. Information is sparse, aligned to viewport edges, and phrased as commands rather than commentary.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black field with chalk-white operational text.
Amber routes, cyan confirms intelligence, and red identifies hostility.
Rectilinear information surfaces contrast with circular touch controls.

rules.name: Signal Ownership
rules.body: Amber guides, cyan confirms intelligence, and red identifies danger.

rules.name: Command Voice
rules.body: Objectives and buttons use verbs and avoid decorative technical jargon.

rules.name: Overlay Restraint
rules.body: Gameplay panels may darken the scene but never become decorative glass.

dos: Do keep the reticle and central enemy silhouette unobstructed.
Do make state understandable from wording and silhouette as well as color.
Do retain one dominant action per non-gameplay screen.
donts: Don't introduce legacy branding or imported imagery.
Don't add semantic accents merely to balance a composition.
Don't place printed text inside the procedural 3D world.
